title: What’s the one thing you’d struggle to let go of… if Jesus asked for it?
paragraphs:
What’s the one thing you’d struggle to let go of… if Jesus asked for it?
He wasn’t condemned for having wealth.
He was exposed for being owned by it.
Some blessings become cages when we won’t surrender them.

He ran to Jesus.
He left slowly.

Not because he lacked faith—
but because he loved comfort more than calling.

This story isn’t about money.
It’s about attachment.

You can look successful. Moral. Disciplined.
And still walk away from freedom because it costs control.

Some people want heaven.
Few want surrender.
“Freedom feels expensive… until you realize what staying bound costs.”
